name: SKULL-3
tagline: A silenced anti-zombie UMP45 that can be dual-wielded on the fly.
summary: SKULL-3 is an anti-zombie submachine gun chambered with 35 rounds of .45 Anti-Zombie cartridge that can be dual-wielded for 70 rounds. It carries a non-detachable suppressor, foregrip, an extended magazine (+10 over the UMP45) and a scope usable in single mode. Single mode is light and accurate; dual mode trades weight and recoil for high damage, rate of fire and penetration.
description: The wiki describes SKULL-3 as an anti-zombie submachine gun chambered with 35 rounds of .45 Anti-Zombie cartridge and capable of being dual-wielded (70 rounds). It includes a non-detachable suppressor, a foregrip, an extended magazine (+10 capacity compared to the UMP) and a scope usable in single mode. It costs $4,000 in both Original and Scenario, with ammo at $1,050 (Original) / $3,000 (Scenario). Damage in single mode (armor / no armor): head 81 / 100+, chest 20 / 28, gut 20 / 28, leg 20 / 21; in dual mode: head 105 / 100+, chest 26 / 35, gut 26 / 35, leg 26 / 26. In zombie modes, 35 rounds of A mode deal roughly 700-2,800 damage and 70 rounds of B mode 1,960-7,840. Recommended use: single mode for medium/long range or escaping, dual mode for close combat and safe-area zombie killing, firing in 3-round bursts.

advantages: Single mode: low recoil, light weight, short reload, usable scope, good long-range accuracy
Dual mode: high damage to humans and zombies, high rate of fire, silent, penetrates up to 4 objects, high stun on zombies, high reserve ammo
disadvantages: Single mode: low damage and magazine capacity, low knockback
Dual mode: very heavy, unusable scope, high recoil, runs dry quickly, expensive, low knockback
trivia: The text 'SKULL-3' appears on the weapon.
Throwing the dual SKULL-3s during reload increases running speed.
An earlier version charged only $35 per 35 bullets.
The scope remains functional despite being obstructed by its cap; it reads 'Aopoint', parodying Aimpoint.
Dual-mode SKULL-3 weighs more than SKULL-4 despite being a submachine gun.
